mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the clinic's dispatch history with depot intake was most worthwhile: it showed how a filter turned real requests into an apparent zero.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to put the dispatch tape directly on the repaired board was frustrating because it gave no clue about the required preparation.

surprise.text: The tape became usable only after volunteered histories were displayed; the resulting board also made the list's incompleteness visible.

arbitrary.text: The ordering of the tape and volunteered histories felt somewhat arbitrary at first, although the completed board gave both a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the neighbors use the corrected evidence, especially after Moth revises its understanding; the repairs were straightforward but the discovery had a satisfying payoff.
